C1.title: The Yeshwanthpur Fencing Ring
C1.summary: A motorcycle theft ring in Bengaluru launders stolen bikes through fake registration transfers sold as 'used vehicles' in Tumakuru. One accused (Suresh) is named inconsistently across the two FIRs - the entity-fusion target. CCTV places him in Tumakuru at a time his own witness statement says he was elsewhere in Bengaluru.

C2.title: K.R. Market Jewellery Heist
C2.summary: An organized gang robs a jewellery shop near K.R. Market, Mysuru, fencing the goods through an unlicensed pawnbroker. A shop assistant (victim) is grabbed and injured during the robbery.

C3.title: QuickCash Loan-App Extortion
C3.summary: An illegal instant-loan app harasses and extorts borrowers across two districts, using leaked contact lists to threaten victims' families. Same operator (Zoya) runs both district-level complaints under different registered-agent names.

C4.title: Kalaburagi Land Title Forgery
C4.summary: A property broker, a complicit notary, and a buyer conspire to forge land title documents for an agricultural plot, defrauding the actual owner.

C5.title: Mangaluru Warehouse Burglary-Resale Ring
C5.summary: A string of electronics-warehouse burglaries in Mangaluru feeds a secondhand electronics shop that resells the goods within days.

C6.title: Ballari Mining Contract Assault
C6.summary: A labor payment dispute at a mining site escalates into a group assault on a worker who raised the issue, allegedly ordered by the contractor.

C7.title: Shivamogga-Tumakuru Cattle Theft Corridor
C7.summary: A rural cattle theft ring moves stolen livestock across a district border overnight to avoid recognition, using a common transporter's truck for both districts' thefts.

C8.title: Whitefield Fake Tech-Support Call Centre
C8.summary: An illegal call centre in Whitefield runs a fake tech-support scam targeting elderly victims across multiple cities, extracting remote-access payments.

C9.title: Mysuru Domestic Dispute Escalation
C9.summary: A domestic assault complaint is followed by witness intimidation - a neighbor who gave an initial statement recants weeks later, but a CCTV timestamp on the intimidation visit conflicts with the accused's claimed whereabouts.

C10.title: Belagavi Auto Chop-Shop
C10.summary: Stolen two-wheelers are stripped for parts at an unlicensed garage and the parts resold separately, making the vehicles themselves untraceable.

C11.title: Kalaburagi Wedding Jewellery Robbery Gang
C11.summary: A gang cases wedding venues via an inside informant (a catering staff member) and robs guests of jewellery during the event.

C12.title: Mangaluru Coastal Investment Ponzi
C12.summary: A fake 'guaranteed returns' investment scheme collects money from dozens of small investors before the operators vanish; two early investors act as unwitting local recruiters.

C13.title: Ballari-Bengaluru ATM Skimming Ring
C13.summary: A skimming device installer, a card-data cloner, and a network of cash-out mules operate across two cities, with the same mule appearing under different first names in each district's FIR.

C14.title: Shivamogga Forest Produce Theft
C14.summary: A sandalwood theft ring operates with an inside tip-off from a forest department watcher, felling trees inside a reserve and moving timber out via an unmonitored route.

C15.title: Bengaluru Turf Assault
C15.summary: A street-gang turf dispute erupts into a multi-person assault outside a college, with dense CCTV coverage typical of an urban setting and conflicting accounts of who struck first.
